title: Config-aware regression gatekeeper for embedding + reranker quality
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: add a config- and model-change-aware regression gatekeeper that runs offline embedding + reranker evals automatically on any PR or config update that touches model, quantization, batching, or reranker weights. The gatekeeper should compute recall/precision deltas on curated holdout sets, run drift statistics on production embedding distributions, and block or flag rollouts if predefined thresholds are crossed. This ticket implements the core CI runner, gating logic, and alerting hooks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A CI job triggers when a PR modifies model/config files and runs the embedding+rerank eval suite against the pinned baseline snapshot. 2) The job computes precision@k, recall@k, MRR, and embedding distance statistics and reports a clear pass/fail decision using configured thresholds. 3) If any metric regresses beyond thresholds, the PR is flagged and an automatic rollback/hold is created for deployments referencing that config/model. 4) Results are logged to Console dashboard with links to the PR and the eval artifacts. 5) Runbook created for oncall to triage gate failures.
implementation_notes:
- Use existing eval harness but extend to be config-aware: compare current model/config to the baseline snapshot identified by model_version + config_hash.
- Baseline snapshots live in s3://redwood-evals/baselines/{model_version}/{config_hash}. Keep snapshot metadata in a versioned index.
- Compute deltas for: precision@1/3/5, recall@1/3/5, MRR, mean cosine distance histogram, PSI (population stability index) for embedding distributions, and token-length distribution changes.
- Thresholds: default precision drop > 2.5% OR recall drop > 3% OR MRR drop > 3% => fail. PSI > 0.15 => warn/fail depending on severity. Make thresholds configurable per-project.
- CI integration: GitHub action that runs the harness in a short-mode using stratified holdouts + 2k sample synthetic adversarial queries. Fall back to longer job in nightly runs.
- Gating behavior: for PRs, comment with a summarized report and block merge if fail. For automated rollouts, prevent canary expansion beyond 5% if fail and create incident ticket.
- Storage: upload full eval artifacts (CSV, histograms, model predictions) to artifacts store and add link to Console.
- Performance: optimize embedding distance computation with approximate nearest neighbor for large sets; for CI use exact on small holdouts.
- Owners: Diego for infra changes, Asha for metric definitions, Priya Rao for dashboarding and alerts.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for metric computations and threshold logic.
- Integration test: simulate a PR that changes config_hash and assert CI run produces expected pass/fail for synthetic regressed model.
- Load test: run short-mode on 10 concurrent PRs to validate runner resource limits.
- Validation: compare CI short-mode results with nightly long-mode to tune sampling parameters so short-mode catches >=90% of regressions found in long-mode.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal): enable for core teams only, post-merge blocking disabled but warnings enforced for 2 weeks. Phase 2 (strict gating): enable merge-blocking for PRs touching configs for all teams, require attestation for overrides. Phase 3 (deploy-time gating): integrate with rollout controller to stop canary progress on failures and create auto incidents. Communicate changes via dev-oncall and runbook.
